item.title: Record Subsurface Warming In Monterey Bay: MBARI logs 18.18°C at 60m; tropical species move north
item.description: Scientists have announced that temperatures at 200 feet off Monterey Bay have reached their highest levels in nearly forty years. This rise is attributed to the forthcoming 2026-27 El Niño, with sightings of tropical species migrating northward, suggesting significant ecological transformations.
